proof_steps.comparison: The finite embedded resolution applies to the compact reduced central divisor, with every centre over it. The proposed proof now names U0, π, the resolved map h-tilde and the exact fibre pullback for Ω_t. These maps transport the integral marking, holomorphic top forms and cup products. proof_steps.fresh_scope: Frozen GA §§4–6 as permitted checked input; frozen GD §3 supplies an additional direct norm argument
proof_steps.comparison: The printed component argument is valid at its asserted scope. GA’s annular divergence eliminates conductor residues using bounded periods alone. GA’s coefficient-ideal residue argument and primitive order contradiction rule out Ω vanishing on every branch, again without using geometric genus. Thus some component restriction is a nonzero holomorphic two-form. The frozen GD proof independently obtains positive limiting norm by the real-analytic minimum argument and a_i<m_i, with no component-genus assumption.

proof_steps.fresh_scope: Frozen GD §3; frozen GA local coordinate and volume estimates
proof_steps.comparison: A point where the component restriction is nonzero gives exponent zero in the actual local model t=z^m, hence a uniform positive integral lower bound. Holomorphic period coordinates and the constant cup pairing then give a positive limit. The proposed wording corrects “flat cohomology class” to a holomorphic class expressed in the flat frame; horizontality of the class itself is neither needed nor asserted.

proof_steps.fresh_scope: Frozen GD §4 and postrelease exact polynomial certificate
proof_steps.comparison: Decomposability is closed and the limiting vector is nonzero. The explicit frozen chart w1=e1−p23/p12 e3−p24/p12 e4, w2=e2+p13/p12 e3+p14/p12 e4 gives v=p12 w1 wedge w2 and the exact two-dimensional kernel of wedge by v. Its coefficients are holomorphic where p12≠0. The nonzero four-form v wedge conjugate(v) gives W⊕conjugate(W)=V. A fresh sparse integer-polynomial program verifies the chart and kernel identities; its timing is postrelease and adds no independent credit.

The evaluation map ι_t(γ)(ω)=<ω,γ> is an isomorphism after real scalar extension because a real functional killing W also kills its conjugate, and the dimensions agree. Uniform lower bounds on compact base sets prove proper discontinuity of lattice translations. The compact marked parallelotope over any compact base set maps onto the quotient preimage, proving properness. Integration identifies the quotient with the relative Albanese groups over the punctured disc through the same period pairing.
